competences.description: Gains Knowledge by the number of granted beneficial effects when you're granted with a beneficial effect. [Automatic Effect]

In addition, if you get defeated while having Knowledge, you will use all of your Knowledge to be revived with 20% HP per Knowledge used. [Automatic Effect]
